title: Scones with Clotted Cream Alternative
description: A vegan twist on a classic British dessert, using chickpea-based clotted cream and served with a side of juicy, smoky fruits.

ingredients.name: chickpea cream
ingredients.notes: made by blending 1 can chickpeas with 1/4 cup maple syrup and 1/4 cup lemon juice

ingredients.name: smoky fruit
ingredients.notes: such as grilled or poached apples or pears

ingredients.name: juicy fruit
ingredients.notes: such as fresh berries or sliced peaches

instructions: Spread a layer of chickpea cream on each scone.
Top with a spoonful of smoky fruit.
Garnish with a sprinkle of juicy fruit.
Serve warm or at room temperature.
Enjoy as a vegan dessert or snack.
